theme: An open Saturday, with Croatia three days out.
greeting: The calendar's clear today, Dan — an open Saturday in St. Pete with the girls. The weight is all pre-Croatia: a Halloween call due today, and a handful of P1 bookings that have to close before you fly Tuesday.

needsAttention.title: Decide Halloween: St. Pete or Maine
needsAttention.detail: The decision is due today, before Croatia. The Oct 18-Nov 1 St. Pete house and car both cover Halloween and re-book while you're away, so a clear 'no' to Maine now is what saves the most work.

needsAttention.title: Confirm Nautilus boarding and return transfer
needsAttention.detail: Due today: pin the Sept 12 boarding time and arrange the Sept 19 airport transfer while you're still on land — charter connectivity won't let you sort it once underway.

needsAttention.title: Get the checked-bag allowance in writing
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags. Confirm the allowance on Eurowings Discover's own site before Tuesday, or two 55L duffels get gate-checked or refused.

needsAttention.title: Book the Cavtat night and transfers
needsAttention.detail: Still open for Sat Sept 19 after the charter — a Cavtat room plus the Komolac transfer and the early Sunday airport run, all bookable only from land before you fly.

needsAttention.title: Cover the St. Pete landing gap
needsAttention.detail: Two nights, Sept 20-21, between landing from Croatia and the Tuesday kid pickup, are still unbooked.

needsAttention.title: Skim the board before Mike's review
needsAttention.detail: The Sunday review with Mike is at 9 AM tomorrow. Arrive having glanced at the Dan & Mike board so the 15 minutes actually clears the inbox instead of filling it.

flagged.title: ICGN Toronto conference open for booking
flagged.detail: The ICGN Autumn Conference runs in November in Toronto and registration's now open — worth a look for the governance network.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promos — Nautilus, Airbnb, West Marine.

resolved.title: UN PRI call parked until you're back
resolved.detail: You replied Friday asking to push the Conor Kehoe conversation past your trip, and his office confirmed they'll revisit the diary when you return — nothing owed now.

recipe.title: Chestnut and Pancetta Salad
recipe.why: An autumn plate that leans on chestnuts and cool-weather greens just coming into season.

tasks.title: Book refundable backup car, or confirm Mike's is en route
Buy EU plug adapters + a power strip

acts.line: A quiet Saturday start — the calendar holds only the St. Pete stay.
Wide open through the middle of the day, three days out from the boat.
The day winds down toward an early week and a long trip ahead.
